Search.Name: Objects by Change object (in selected package)

RootTable.Filter:
SELECT o.ea_guid AS CLASSGUID, o.Object_Type AS CLASSTYPE, re.Name AS Scope, cr.Name AS Change, cr.Note, cr.Note as ChangeDescription, o.name AS ChangedItem, case when charindex('date=', op.Notes) > 0 then substring(op.Notes, charindex('date=',op.[Notes]) + len('date='),10) else '' end as ChangeDate, case when charindex('user=',op.[Notes]) > 0 then substring(op.Notes,charindex('user=',op.[Notes]) + len('user='),charindex(';date=', op.[Notes]) - (charindex('user=',op.[Notes]) + len('user='))) else '' end as UserName, case when charindex('comments=',op.[Notes]) > 0 then substring(op.Notes,charindex('comments=',op.[Notes]) + len('comments='),500) else '' end as ChangeComments, package.name AS PackageName, package_p1.name AS Package_level1, package_p2.name AS Package_level2, package_p3.name AS Package_level3 FROM ((((((((t_object o INNER JOIN t_objectproperties op ON o.Object_ID = op.Object_ID) INNER JOIN t_object cr ON cr.ea_guid = op.value) LEFT JOIN (select crre.Start_Object_ID, re.Name from t_connector crre INNER JOIN t_object re ON (re.Object_Id = crre.End_Object_Id AND re.StereoType = 'Scope')) re ON re.Start_Object_ID = cr.Object_Id) INNER JOIN t_package package ON o.package_id = package.package_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p1 ON package_p1.package_id = package.parent_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p2 ON package_p2.package_id = package_p1.parent_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p3 ON package_p3.package_id = package_p2.parent_id) left join t_package pp on pp.ea_guid = o.ea_guid) WHERE op.Property = 'CM::CR' and cr.Name like '#WC#<Search Term>#WC#' AND ( o.Package_ID IN (#Branch#) or pp.Package_ID = #Package# )
UNION
SELECT a.ea_guid AS CLASSGUID, 'Attribute' AS CLASSTYPE, re.Name AS Scope, cr.Name AS Change, cr.Note, cr.Note as ChangeDescription, o.name +'.'+ a.Name AS ChangedItem, case when charindex('date=', atv.Notes) > 0 then substring(atv.Notes, charindex('date=',atv.[Notes]) + len('date='),10) else '' end as ChangeDate, case when charindex('user=',atv.[Notes]) > 0 then substring(atv.Notes,charindex('user=',atv.[Notes]) + len('user='),charindex(';date=', atv.[Notes]) - (charindex('user=',atv.[Notes]) + len('user='))) else '' end as UserName, case when charindex('comments=',atv.[Notes]) > 0 then substring(atv.Notes,charindex('comments=',atv.[Notes]) + len('comments='),500) else '' end as ChangeComments, package.name AS PackageName, package_p1.name AS Package_level1, package_p2.name AS Package_level2, package_p3.name AS Package_level3 FROM ((((((((t_attribute a INNER JOIN t_attributetag atv ON a.ID = atv.ElementID) INNER JOIN t_object cr ON cr.ea_guid = atv.value) LEFT JOIN (select crre.Start_Object_ID, re.Name from t_connector crre INNER JOIN t_object re ON (re.Object_Id = crre.End_Object_Id AND re.StereoType = 'Scope')) re ON re.Start_Object_ID = cr.Object_Id) INNER JOIN t_object o ON a.Object_ID = o.Object_ID) INNER JOIN t_package package ON o.package_id = package.package_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p1 ON package_p1.package_id = package.parent_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p2 ON package_p2.package_id = package_p1.parent_id) LEFT JOIN t_package package_p3 ON package_p3.package_id = package_p2.parent_id) WHERE atv.Property = 'CM::CR' and cr.Name like '#WC#<Search Term>#WC#' AND o.Package_ID IN (#Branch#) ORDER BY Scope, Change, ChangedItem
